scope: Megatron-Core TP=2 PP=1 FP32 custom-loop smoke test; excluded from benchmark evidence

observed_failure.exception: ValueError: Expected input batch_size (256) to match target batch_size (512).
observed_failure.cause: MCore GPTModel defaults to vocab-parallel output at TP=2. Each rank returned 25,152 vocabulary logits, but the baseline applied ordinary full-vocabulary torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy against the 50,304-vocabulary labels.
observed_failure.why_it_matters: The pre-fix baseline cannot support a TP=2 throughput or numerical-equivalence claim; it did not execute a valid loss.

resolution.change: Set GPTModel(parallel_output=False) in eval/run_megatron_baseline.py so MCore gathers full vocabulary logits before the shared ordinary CE path.
resolution.verification: The corrected TP=2 PP=1 one-update smoke test completed on 2026-08-21. It is diagnostic only: no shared checkpoint, fixed batch artifact, parity gate, or paired timing was used.

evidence_policy: diagnostic_only; never include in paired throughput aggregates or published performance conclusions
